change: Block negative learned residual when depth_minus_target <= 0 and measured downward_speed < -0.3 cm/s
evaluation: Paired frozen-dynamics float-student simulation; existing held-out recording, stride 4; no water validation
steady_hold_definition: Starting absolute depth error <= 2 cm and absolute speed <= 0.3 cm/s
limitations: Float policy simulation, not new INT8 closed-loop validation or proof of real-water improvement. Existing learned dynamics and held-out data have been used in earlier development.
